title: ScopedRepo no longer falls back to another user's HttpSession: with no request-bound session it returns null (fail closed) and SessionService stops publishing the last form-login's session

criteria.then: it holds no cached fallback session and has no setSession()/HttpSessionCreatedEvent listener: getSession() answers only from the current request
it no longer registers the logging-in user's HttpSession as a process-wide session
ScopedRepoTest and the SessionService cross-session tests exist
